column1: # Hand labels for iteration 4 of the engineering-role loop (issue #10).
# The 1000 rows sampled by iteration 3, in docs/measurements/engineering-role-2026-09-23.md.
# Labelled on 2026-09-21 from docs/engineering-role-criterion.md alone, at revision
# 33113b2f832188092b8f9b8cb1ac763bca5f43d2, over the bare cleaned titles, before any rule of
# the classifier was read. Never regenerated: a session is not reproducible, so these labels
# are the artifact and not the process that made them.
# id
# SUPERSEDED CONVENTIONS. This fixture was labelled before ADR-0010 and the criterion revision
# of 2026-09-22. The rows are never rewritten — they are the artifact — but the families below
# were labelled under rules the criterion no longer holds, so a session pricing a candidate rule
# against the accumulated labels treats them as evidence-free rather than as costs:
#   - A title carrying both an off-domain marker and a software qualifier. The old step 4 let
#     every marker beat the qualifier; a market marker no longer does.
#   - A hardware-adjacent code role (fpga, asic, rtl, gnc, emulation, signal processing). Q2 and
#     Q4 were unranked and three labellers split the family three ways; the discipline marker
#     decides it now.
#   - A domain-free head with a market modifier (Treasury Analyst, Management Analyst). Labellers
#     resolved these on judgement; the criterion says they are unknown.
#   - A post that hires nobody (talent community, general application, refer a friend). The Q1
#     vacancy gate did not exist when this fixture was labelled.
# SUPERSEDED BY THE CRITERION REVISION OF 2026-09-24. The rows are never rewritten, but the
# families below were labelled before the criterion decided them, so a session pricing a
# candidate rule against the accumulated labels treats them as evidence-free rather than as
# costs:
#   - Managers: a manager over a technology noun (IT, Data, Security, Salesforce Manager) is now
#     scope_ambiguity, and a bare Engineering Manager, with or without a market marker, is now
#     domain_ambiguity.
#   - Technical Product Manager and Technical Program Manager are now IN; Technical Project
#     Manager is now domain_ambiguity.
#   - AI-training posts: the expertise named decides, and a post that names none is now
#     scope_ambiguity.
#   - Named enterprise packages (SAP, Salesforce, Oracle EBS, NetSuite, Workday) under consultant,
#     analyst or administrator are now scope_ambiguity.
#   - Reasons only, not states: a product title with no software qualifier is now
#     scope_ambiguity, and the two corpus reasons were redefined as "the domain is unclear" and
#     "the expertise is unclear".
